ALLURE_OF_FLAME.desc: Stamp a %s to target Coin Piece.
ALLURE_OF_FLAME.name: Allure of Flame

ATROPHY.desc: Stamp a %s to target Coin Piece.
ATROPHY.name: Atrophy

BURNING_OBSESSION.desc: Gain %sx Total Spin. If %d+ Spin was Gained and this Ability is not a Copy, Activate a Copy of target Coin Piece's Ability. Otherwise, Stamp a %s on target Coin Piece.
BURNING_OBSESSION.name: Burning Obsession

CLING_TO_LIFE.desc: Opponent Loses Spin equal to half the difference between yours'.
CLING_TO_LIFE.name: Cling to Life

CONSUME_THE_STARS.desc: Break the Seal on target Coin Piece and all adjacent Coin Pieces, then gain %d Spin for each Seal Broken. If %d+ Seals are Broken, Stamp a %s to another target Coin Piece.
CONSUME_THE_STARS.name: Consume The Stars

DEVOUR.desc: The owner of targe Coin Piece Gains %d Spin. If it has a Seal, Break it and Stamp a %s on that Coin Piece.
DEVOUR.name: Devour

DRAG_TO_SEA.desc: Break target Seal. Then Stamp a Copy of that Seal to this Coin Piece.
DRAG_TO_SEA.name: Drag to Sea

FOG_OF_MIND.desc: Stamp a %s on target Coin Piece and a %s on a random adjacent Coin Piece. Then Stamp a %s on this Coin Piece.
FOG_OF_MIND.name: Fog of Mind

FORMLESS_LIKE_WATER.desc: If you own target Coin Piece, Break its Seal. Otherwise, its owner Loses %d Spin. Then activate a Copy of its Ability if this Ability is not a Copy.
FORMLESS_LIKE_WATER.name: Formless, Like Water

HESITANCE.desc: Stamp a %s to target Coin Piece.
HESITANCE.name: Hesitance

HORROR_VACUI.desc: Gain %d Spin. Stamp a %s on this and all adjacent Coin Pieces.
HORROR_VACUI.name: Horror Vacui

OCEANS_DESCENT.desc: Stamp a %s to target Coin Piece.
OCEANS_DESCENT.flavor: You will be crushed beneath the endless tide!
OCEANS_DESCENT.name: Ocean's Descent

PHASE_CHANGE.desc: If this Ability is not a Copy, Opponent Loses %d Spin. Otherwise, Break target Seal.
PHASE_CHANGE.name: Phase Change

PLAY_WITH_YOUR_FOOD.desc: Stamp a %s on target Coin Piece and a %s to a random Coin Piece adjacent to it.
PLAY_WITH_YOUR_FOOD.name: Play With Your Food

PLUNGE_INTO_DARKNESS.desc: Both players Lose %d Spin. Break target Seal. If you owned that Seal, gain %d Spin. Otherwise, Break another target Seal.
PLUNGE_INTO_DARKNESS.name: Plunge into Darkness

SALT_THE_EARTH.desc: Stamp a %s on target Coin Piece, then Lose %d Spin.
SALT_THE_EARTH.name: Salt the Earth

SEAL_AWAY.desc: Stamp a %s on target Coin Piece and this Coin Piece.
SEAL_AWAY.name: Seal Away

SIRENS_CALL.desc: Opponent loses %d Spin. Can only be Activated if your Spin is less than 0.
SIRENS_CALL.name: Sirens' Call

UNCHARTED_WATERS.desc: Stamp a %s to target Coin Piece. Then activate a Copy of its Ability.
UNCHARTED_WATERS.name: Uncharted Waters

AMAZONITE_CLUSTER_RING.desc: At the Start of each Round, for each Player, Stamp a %s to a random Coin Piece they own, %d times.
AMAZONITE_CLUSTER_RING.name: Amazonite Cluster Ring

AZURITE_FACET_RING.desc: After a player Skips their Turn, Stamp a %s on a random Coin Piece you own.
AZURITE_FACET_RING.name: Azurite Facet Ring

BAND_OF_A_THOUSAND_CUTS.desc: When a player Loses Spin, Gain %d Spin.
BAND_OF_A_THOUSAND_CUTS.name: Band of a Thousand Cuts

BLANK_BAND.desc: When an Ability is Countered or a Turn is Skipped, gain %d Spin.
BLANK_BAND.name: Blank Brand

BOW_OF_BELLS_END.desc:
At the Start of each Round, Stamp a %s to each Coin Piece you own.
On Your Last Turn, take an Additional Turn after that.
BOW_OF_BELLS_END.name: Bow of Bell's End

BUCKET_BRIM_CRUSTACEAN.desc: When you would Lose Spin on your Turn, %d%% chance to gain that much instead.
BUCKET_BRIM_CRUSTACEAN.name: Bucket Brim Crustacean

CIRCLE_OF_LEECHES.desc:
After an Ability of a Coin Piece you own is Activated, Stamp a %s to it.
After a %s is Broken from a Coin Piece you own, Stamp a %s to it.
CIRCLE_OF_LEECHES.name: Circle of Leeches

CROWN_OF_PRIMAE_NOCTIS.desc: At the Start of each Round, Choose an Opponent's Coin Piece and Activate a Copy of its Ability.
CROWN_OF_PRIMAE_NOCTIS.name: Crown of Primae Noctis

DUAL_TUNGSTEN_SIGNATE.desc: At the Start of each Round, lose %d Spin and Activate a Copy of an Ability of target Coin Piece you own.
DUAL_TUNGSTEN_SIGNATE.name: Dual Tungsten Signate

PRESERVER_OF_THE_DROWNED.desc: The first time each Round your Spin becomes less than 0, gain %d Spin.
PRESERVER_OF_THE_DROWNED.name: Preserver of the Drowned

TWIN_HEADED_OUROBOROS.desc:
On Your First Turn, after you Activate an Ability, Activate a Copy of it.
On Your Last Turn, when you Activate an Ability, Counter it.
TWIN_HEADED_OUROBOROS.name: Twin-Headed Ouroboros

AQUA_FORTIS.desc: At the Start of your Turn, Gain %d Spin.
AQUA_FORTIS.name: Aqua Fortis

ARSENIC.desc: After the Ability of this Coin Piece is activated, Break this Seal and Lose %d Spin.
ARSENIC.name: Arsenic

BLACK_SULFUR.desc: At the Start of your Turn, Lose %d Spin.
BLACK_SULFUR.name: Black Sulfur

CLEANSING.desc: At the End of your Turn, Break this and all adjacent Seals.
CLEANSING.name: Cleansing

COPPER.desc: At the End of your Turn, if an Ability of this Coin Piece was Activated, Lose %d Spin and Break this Seal. Otherwise, gain %d Spin.
COPPER.name: Copper

CRYSTALLIZATION.desc: The Ability of this Coin Piece cannot be Activated. At the End of your next Turn, Break this Seal.
CRYSTALLIZATION.name: Crystallization

LEAD.desc: The next time an Ability of this Coin Piece would be Activated, Counter that Activation and Break this Seal.
LEAD.name: Lead

QUICKSILVER.desc: After an Ability of this Coin Piece is Activated, Lose %d Spin.
QUICKSILVER.name: Quicksilver

WAX.desc: The Ability of this Coin Piece can't be Activated. After you Skip your Turn, Break this Seal.
WAX.name: Wax
